  // PWA Prompt
  var _useState51 = useState(null),

  useEffect(function () {

  }, []);
  var handleInstallPwa = function handleInstallPwa() {
    if (deferredPrompt) {
      deferredPrompt.prompt();
      deferredPrompt.userChoice.then(function (choice) {
        if (choice.outcome === 'accepted') {
          showToast('Aplicativo instalado com sucesso!');
        }
        setDeferredPrompt(null);
      });
    } else {
      setPwaGuideModal(true);

  // A. Troca Rápida de Perfil (Role Switcher)
  var switchRole = function switchRole(role) {
    if (role === 'dono') {
      setCurrentUser({
        role: 'dono',
        name: 'Luis Valverde',
        title: 'Proprietário & Barbeiro',
        barberKey: 'luis',
        avatar: 'luis_valverde.jpg'
      });
      setCurrentView('painel');
    } else if (role === 'barbeiro') {
      setCurrentUser({
        role: 'barbeiro',
        name: 'Yago Barber',
        title: 'Barbeiro Especialista',
        barberKey: 'yago',
        avatar: 'yago_barber.png'
      });
      setCurrentView('painel');
      setBarberSubView('hoje');
    } else if (role === 'cliente') {
      setCurrentUser({
        role: 'cliente',
        name: 'Roberto Andrade',
        title: 'Cliente VIP Ouro',
        avatar: 'luis_valverde.jpg'
      });
      setCurrentView('painel');
      setClientStep('home');
    } else if (role === 'dev_marketing') {
      setCurrentUser({
        role: 'dev_marketing',
        name: 'Controle de Marketing',
        title: 'Acesso Desenvolvedor / Growth',
        avatar: 'logo_valverds_clean.png'
      });
      setCurrentView('painel');
      setMarketingSubView('regua');
    }
  };

  // B. Aplicação de Cupom no Wizard de Agendamento
  var handleApplyCoupon = function handleApplyCoupon() {
    var cleanCode = inputCouponCode.trim().toUpperCase();
    if (!cleanCode) {
      setCouponFeedback({
        error: 'Digite um código de cupom válido.'
      });
      return;
    }
    var found = coupons.find(function (c) {
      return c.code.toUpperCase() === cleanCode && c.active;
    });
    if (!found) {
      setCouponFeedback({
        error: 'Cupom inválido ou expirado.'
      });
      setAppliedCoupon(null);
      return;
    }

    // Verifica regra de inatividade caso aplicável
    if (found.minDays > 0) {
      // Exemplo de regra
      var clientData = crmClients.find(function (c) {
        return c.name.toLowerCase() === clientFormName.toLowerCase();
      });
      if (clientData && clientData.daysInactive < found.minDays) {
        setCouponFeedback({
          error: "Este cupom \xE9 exclusivo para clientes ausentes h\xE1 +".concat(found.minDays, " dias.")
        });
        return;
      }
    }
    setAppliedCoupon(found);
    setCouponFeedback({
      success: "Cupom ".concat(found.code, " aplicado com sucesso!")
    });
    showToast("Cupom ".concat(found.code, " ativado!"));
  };

  // Cálculo do valor com desconto
  var calculatedTotal = useMemo(function () {
    var base = selectedService ? selectedService.price : 40;
    if (!appliedCoupon) return {
      base: base,
      discount: 0,
      "final": base
    };
    var discount = 0;
    if (appliedCoupon.type === 'percent') {
      discount = base * appliedCoupon.value / 100;
    } else {
      discount = appliedCoupon.value;
    }
    discount = Math.min(discount, base);
    return {
      base: base,
      discount: discount,
      "final": base - discount
    };
  }, [selectedService, appliedCoupon]);

  // C. Concluir Agendamento no Wizard
  var handleConfirmBooking = function handleConfirmBooking() {
    var newApt = {
      id: Date.now(),
      client: clientFormName,
      phone: clientFormPhone,
      service: selectedService.name,
      barber: selectedBarber.name,
      time: selectedTime,
      status: 'aguardando',
      price: selectedService.price,
      discount: calculatedTotal.discount,
      total: calculatedTotal["final"],
      paymentMethod: '',
      notes: appliedCoupon ? "Cupom aplicado: ".concat(appliedCoupon.code) : 'Agendado pelo App'
    };
    setAppointments(function (prev) {
      return [].concat(_toConsumableArray(prev), [newApt]);
    });

    // Atualiza contador do cupom se usado
    if (appliedCoupon) {
      setCoupons(function (prev) {
        return prev.map(function (c) {
          return c.code === appliedCoupon.code ? _objectSpread(_objectSpread({}, c), {}, {
            usageCount: c.usageCount + 1
          }) : c;
        });
      });
    }
    showToast('Agendamento realizado com sucesso!');
    setWizardStep(1);
    setClientStep('home');
  };

  // D. Ações do Barbeiro
  var handleStartAppointment = function handleStartAppointment(id) {
    setAppointments(function (prev) {
      return prev.map(function (a) {
        return a.id === id ? _objectSpread(_objectSpread({}, a), {}, {
          status: 'em_atendimento'
        }) : a;
      });
    });
    showToast('Cliente chamado para a cadeira!');
  };
  var handleFinishAppointment = function handleFinishAppointment(id) {
    var paymentMethod = arguments.length > 1 && arguments[1] !== undefined ? arguments[1] : 'PIX';
    setAppointments(function (prev) {
      return prev.map(function (a) {
        return a.id === id ? _objectSpread(_objectSpread({}, a), {}, {
          status: 'concluido',
          paymentMethod: paymentMethod
        }) : a;
      });
    });
    showToast('Atendimento finalizado com sucesso! Comissão registrada.');
  };

  // E. Adicionar Produto à Comanda
  var handleAddProductToAppointment = function handleAddProductToAppointment(appointmentId, product) {
    setAppointments(function (prev) {
      return prev.map(function (a) {
        if (a.id === appointmentId) {
          var newTotal = a.total + product.price;
          return _objectSpread(_objectSpread({}, a), {}, {
            total: newTotal,
            notes: a.notes + " | + ".concat(product.name, " (R$ ").concat(product.price, ")")
          });
        }
        return a;
      });
    });
    // Reduz estoque
    setProducts(function (prev) {
      return prev.map(function (p) {
        return p.id === product.id ? _objectSpread(_objectSpread({}, p), {}, {
          stock: Math.max(0, p.stock - 1)
        }) : p;
      });
    });
    setQuickAddProductModal({
      isOpen: false,
      appointmentId: null
    });
    showToast("Adicionado: ".concat(product.name, " (R$ ").concat(product.price, ")"));
  };

  // F. Criar Novo Cupom
  var handleSaveNewCoupon = function handleSaveNewCoupon(e) {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!newCouponForm.code.trim()) return;
    var couponObj = {
      code: newCouponForm.code.trim().toUpperCase(),
      type: newCouponForm.type,
      value: Number(newCouponForm.value),
      minDays: Number(newCouponForm.minDays || 0),
      expiresAt: newCouponForm.expiresAt || '2026-12-31',
      active: true,
      usageCount: 0,
      desc: newCouponForm.desc || "Cupom ".concat(newCouponForm.code)
    };
    setCoupons(function (prev) {
      return [couponObj].concat(_toConsumableArray(prev));
    });
    setNewCouponModal(false);
    setNewCouponForm({
      code: '',
      type: 'percent',
      value: 15,
      minDays: 20,
      expiresAt: '2026-12-31',
      desc: ''
    });
    showToast("Cupom ".concat(couponObj.code, " criado com sucesso!"));
  };
  var handleToggleCoupon = function handleToggleCoupon(code) {
    setCoupons(function (prev) {
      return prev.map(function (c) {
        return c.code === code ? _objectSpread(_objectSpread({}, c), {}, {
          active: !c.active
        }) : c;
      });
    });
    showToast('Status do cupom atualizado.');
  };

  // G. Disparo de Mensagem de Retenção (E-mail / WhatsApp)
  var handleTriggerMarketing = function handleTriggerMarketing(client) {
    var channel = arguments.length > 1 && arguments[1] !== undefined ? arguments[1] : 'whatsapp';
    // Seleciona o melhor cupom com base nos dias sem vir
    var recommendedCoupon = coupons.find(function (c) {
      return c.code === 'BEMVINDO10';
    });
    if (client.daysInactive >= 60) recommendedCoupon = coupons.find(function (c) {
      return c.code === 'RESGATE25';
    }) || recommendedCoupon;else if (client.daysInactive >= 35) recommendedCoupon = coupons.find(function (c) {
      return c.code === 'SAUDADES20';
    }) || recommendedCoupon;else if (client.daysInactive >= 20) recommendedCoupon = coupons.find(function (c) {
      return c.code === 'VOLTEI15';
    }) || recommendedCoupon;
    setMarketingModal({
      isOpen: true,
      client: client,
      coupon: recommendedCoupon,
      channel: channel
    });
  };
  var handleConfirmSendMarketing = function handleConfirmSendMarketing() {
    if (!marketingModal.client || !marketingModal.coupon) return;
    var client = marketingModal.client,
      coupon = marketingModal.coupon,
      channel = marketingModal.channel;
    if (channel === 'whatsapp') {
      var text = encodeURIComponent("Ol\xE1, ".concat(client.name, "! Tudo bem?\n\nAqui \xE9 da Valverd's BarberShop \uD83D\uDC88.\n\nNotamos que faz ").concat(client.daysInactive, " dias desde seu \xFAltimo corte com ").concat(client.favoriteBarber, ". Para voc\xEA voltar e dar aquele alinhamento de respeito no visual, preparamos um benef\xEDcio exclusivo:\n\n\u2702\uFE0F Use o cupom *").concat(coupon.code, "* e ganhe *").concat(coupon.type === 'percent' ? coupon.value + '%' : 'R$ ' + coupon.value, " de desconto* no seu agendamento esta semana!\n\nAgende direto pelo nosso app ou responda esta mensagem para reservarmos seu hor\xE1rio. Te aguardamos!"));
      window.open("https://wa.me/55".concat(client.phone.replace(/\D/g, ''), "?text=").concat(text), '_blank');
      showToast("Conversa aberta com ".concat(client.name, " no WhatsApp!"));
    } else {
      // Simula envio de e-mail
      showToast("E-mail com cupom ".concat(coupon.code, " enviado para ").concat(client.email, "!"));
    }

    // Atualiza data do último contato
    setCrmClients(function (prev) {
      return prev.map(function (c) {
        return c.id === client.id ? _objectSpread(_objectSpread({}, c), {}, {
          lastContact: new Date().toLocaleDateString('pt-BR')
        }) : c;
      });
    });
    setMarketingModal({
      isOpen: false,
      client: null,
      coupon: null
    });
  };

  // =========================================================================
  // DADOS COMPUTADOS (KPIs & Filtros)
  // =========================================================================

  // Barbeiro Ativo (se estiver no modo barbeiro)
  var currentBarberAppointments = useMemo(function () {
    return appointments.filter(function (a) {
      return a.barber === currentUser.name || currentUser.role === 'barbeiro' && a.barber.includes('Yago');
    });
  }, [appointments, currentUser]);
  var inChairAppointment = useMemo(function () {
    return currentBarberAppointments.find(function (a) {
      return a.status === 'em_atendimento';
    });
  }, [currentBarberAppointments]);
  var nextAppointment = useMemo(function () {
    return currentBarberAppointments.find(function (a) {
      return a.status === 'aguardando';
    });
  }, [currentBarberAppointments]);
  var barberEarningsToday = useMemo(function () {
    var completed = currentBarberAppointments.filter(function (a) {
      return a.status === 'concluido';
    });
    var revenue = completed.reduce(function (acc, a) {
      return acc + (a.total || a.price);
    }, 0);
    return {
      count: completed.length,
      revenue: revenue,
      commission: revenue * 0.50
    };
  }, [currentBarberAppointments]);

  // Métricas do Dono
  var ownerMetrics = useMemo(function () {
    var completed = appointments.filter(function (a) {
      return a.status === 'concluido';
    });
    var revenue = completed.reduce(function (acc, a) {
      return acc + (a.total || a.price);
    }, 0);
    var inServiceCount = appointments.filter(function (a) {
      return a.status === 'em_atendimento';
    }).length;
    var waitingCount = appointments.filter(function (a) {
      return a.status === 'aguardando';
    }).length;
    return {
      totalCompleted: completed.length,
      revenue: revenue,
      inServiceCount: inServiceCount,
      waitingCount: waitingCount,
      ticketMedio: completed.length ? revenue / completed.length : 0
    };
  }, [appointments]);

  // Filtro CRM de Clientes
  var filteredCrmClients = useMemo(function () {
    if (crmFilter === 'em_dia') return crmClients.filter(function (c) {
      return c.daysInactive <= 20;
    });
    if (crmFilter === 'retorno') return crmClients.filter(function (c) {
      return c.daysInactive > 20 && c.daysInactive <= 35;
    });
    if (crmFilter === 'ausente') return crmClients.filter(function (c) {
      return c.daysInactive > 35 && c.daysInactive <= 60;
    });
    if (crmFilter === 'inativo') return crmClients.filter(function (c) {
      return c.daysInactive > 60;
    });
    return crmClients;
  }, [crmClients, crmFilter]);

    // =========================================================================
    // COMPONENTE PRINCIPAL: VALVERD'S ENGINE
    // =========================================================================
    function App() {
      // 1. Persistência em LocalStorage
      const [appointments, setAppointments] = useState(() => {
        try {
          const saved = localStorage.getItem('valverds_appointments');
          return saved ? JSON.parse(saved) : INITIAL_APPOINTMENTS;
        } catch (e) { return INITIAL_APPOINTMENTS; }
      });

      const [coupons, setCoupons] = useState(() => {
        try {
          const saved = localStorage.getItem('valverds_coupons');
          return saved ? JSON.parse(saved) : INITIAL_COUPONS;
        } catch (e) { return INITIAL_COUPONS; }
      });

      const [crmClients, setCrmClients] = useState(() => {
        try {
          const saved = localStorage.getItem('valverds_crm_clients');
          return saved ? JSON.parse(saved) : INITIAL_CRM_CLIENTS;
        } catch (e) { return INITIAL_CRM_CLIENTS; }
      });

      const [products, setProducts] = useState(() => {
        try {
          const saved = localStorage.getItem('valverds_products');
          return saved ? JSON.parse(saved) : INITIAL_PRODUCTS;
        } catch (e) { return INITIAL_PRODUCTS; }
      });

      useEffect(() => {
        try { localStorage.setItem('valverds_appointments', JSON.stringify(appointments)); } catch(e) {}
      }, [appointments]);

      useEffect(() => {
        try { localStorage.setItem('valverds_coupons', JSON.stringify(coupons)); } catch(e) {}
      }, [coupons]);

      useEffect(() => {
        try { localStorage.setItem('valverds_crm_clients', JSON.stringify(crmClients)); } catch(e) {}
      }, [crmClients]);

      useEffect(() => {
        try { localStorage.setItem('valverds_products', JSON.stringify(products)); } catch(e) {}
      }, [products]);

      // 2. Controle de Sessão e Perfis (Roles)
      const [currentUser, setCurrentUser] = useState({
        role: 'dono', // 'dono' | 'barbeiro' | 'cliente' | 'dev_marketing'
        name: 'Luis Valverde',
        title: 'Proprietário & Barbeiro',
        barberKey: 'luis',
        avatar: 'luis_valverde.jpg'
      });

      const [currentView, setCurrentView] = useState('site'); // 'site' | 'painel'

      // Sub-abas e Navegação por Etapas (Progressive Disclosure)
      const [barberSubView, setBarberSubView] = useState('hoje'); // 'hoje' | 'escala' | 'semana'
      const [ownerSubView, setOwnerSubView] = useState('operacao'); // 'operacao' | 'caixa' | 'estoque' | 'escalas'
      const [marketingSubView, setMarketingSubView] = useState('regua'); // 'regua' | 'cupons'
      const [crmFilter, setCrmFilter] = useState('todos'); // 'todos' | 'em_dia' | 'retorno' | 'ausente' | 'inativo'

      // Fluxo Guiado de Agendamento do Cliente (Wizard Passo a Passo)
      const [clientStep, setClientStep] = useState('home'); // 'home' | 'wizard' | 'fidelidade' | 'historico'
      const [wizardStep, setWizardStep] = useState(1); // 1: Serviço, 2: Barbeiro, 3: Horário, 4: Confirmação & Cupom
      const [selectedService, setSelectedService] = useState(SERVICES_LIST[0]);
      const [selectedBarber, setSelectedBarber] = useState(BARBERS_DATA[0]);
      const [selectedDate, setSelectedDate] = useState('Hoje (09/09)');
      const [selectedTime, setSelectedTime] = useState('14:30');
      const [clientFormName, setClientFormName] = useState('Roberto Andrade');
      const [clientFormPhone, setClientFormPhone] = useState('(21) 98877-1122');
      const [inputCouponCode, setInputCouponCode] = useState('');
      const [appliedCoupon, setAppliedCoupon] = useState(null);
      const [couponFeedback, setCouponFeedback] = useState(null);

      // Modais e Feedback
      const [marketingModal, setMarketingModal] = useState({ isOpen: false, client: null, coupon: null });
      const [newCouponModal, setNewCouponModal] = useState(false);
      const [newCouponForm, setNewCouponForm] = useState({
        code: '',
        type: 'percent',
        value: 15,
        minDays: 20,
        expiresAt: '2026-12-31',
        desc: ''
      });
      const [quickAddProductModal, setQuickAddProductModal] = useState({ isOpen: false, appointmentId: null });
      const [toast, setToast] = useState(null);
      const showToast = (message, type = 'success') => {
        setToast({ message, type });
        setTimeout(() => setToast(null), 4000);
      };

      // PWA Prompt
      const [deferredPrompt, setDeferredPrompt] = useState(null);
      const [isPwaInstalled, setIsPwaInstalled] = useState(false);
      const [pwaGuideModal, setPwaGuideModal] = useState(false);

      useEffect(() => {
        window.addEventListener('beforeinstallprompt', (e) => {
          e.preventDefault();
          setDeferredPrompt(e);
        });
        window.addEventListener('appinstalled', () => {
          setIsPwaInstalled(true);
          showToast('Aplicativo Valverd\'s instalado com sucesso!');
        });
      }, []);

      const handleInstallPwa = () => {
        if (deferredPrompt) {
          deferredPrompt.prompt();
          deferredPrompt.userChoice.then((choice) => {
            if (choice.outcome === 'accepted') {
              showToast('Aplicativo instalado com sucesso!');
            }
            setDeferredPrompt(null);
          });
        } else {
          setPwaGuideModal(true);
        }
      };

      // =========================================================================
      // FUNÇÕES DE AÇÃO E CONTROLE
      // =========================================================================

      // A. Troca Rápida de Perfil (Role Switcher)
      const switchRole = (role) => {
        if (role === 'dono') {
          setCurrentUser({
            role: 'dono',
            name: 'Luis Valverde',
            title: 'Proprietário & Barbeiro',
            barberKey: 'luis',
            avatar: 'luis_valverde.jpg'
          });
          setCurrentView('painel');
        } else if (role === 'barbeiro') {
          setCurrentUser({
            role: 'barbeiro',
            name: 'Yago Barber',
            title: 'Barbeiro Especialista',
            barberKey: 'yago',
            avatar: 'yago_barber.png'
          });
          setCurrentView('painel');
          setBarberSubView('hoje');
        } else if (role === 'cliente') {
          setCurrentUser({
            role: 'cliente',
            name: 'Roberto Andrade',
            title: 'Cliente VIP Ouro',
            avatar: 'luis_valverde.jpg'
          });
          setCurrentView('painel');
          setClientStep('home');
        } else if (role === 'dev_marketing') {
          setCurrentUser({
            role: 'dev_marketing',
            name: 'Controle de Marketing',
            title: 'Acesso Desenvolvedor / Growth',
            avatar: 'logo_valverds_clean.png'
          });
          setCurrentView('painel');
          setMarketingSubView('regua');
        }
      };

      // B. Aplicação de Cupom no Wizard de Agendamento
      const handleApplyCoupon = () => {
        const cleanCode = inputCouponCode.trim().toUpperCase();
        if (!cleanCode) {
          setCouponFeedback({ error: 'Digite um código de cupom válido.' });
          return;
        }
        const found = coupons.find(c => c.code.toUpperCase() === cleanCode && c.active);
        if (!found) {
          setCouponFeedback({ error: 'Cupom inválido ou expirado.' });
          setAppliedCoupon(null);
          return;
        }

        // Verifica regra de inatividade caso aplicável
        if (found.minDays > 0) {
          // Exemplo de regra
          const clientData = crmClients.find(c => c.name.toLowerCase() === clientFormName.toLowerCase());
          if (clientData && clientData.daysInactive < found.minDays) {
            setCouponFeedback({ error: `Este cupom é exclusivo para clientes ausentes há +${found.minDays} dias.` });
            return;
          }
        }

        setAppliedCoupon(found);
        setCouponFeedback({ success: `Cupom ${found.code} aplicado com sucesso!` });
        showToast(`Cupom ${found.code} ativado!`);
      };

      // Cálculo do valor com desconto
      const calculatedTotal = useMemo(() => {
        let base = selectedService ? selectedService.price : 40;
        if (!appliedCoupon) return { base, discount: 0, final: base };
        let discount = 0;
        if (appliedCoupon.type === 'percent') {
          discount = (base * appliedCoupon.value) / 100;
        } else {
          discount = appliedCoupon.value;
        }
        discount = Math.min(discount, base);
        return { base, discount, final: base - discount };
      }, [selectedService, appliedCoupon]);

      // C. Concluir Agendamento no Wizard
      const handleConfirmBooking = () => {
        const newApt = {
          id: Date.now(),
          client: clientFormName,
          phone: clientFormPhone,
          service: selectedService.name,
          barber: selectedBarber.name,
          time: selectedTime,
          status: 'aguardando',
          price: selectedService.price,
          discount: calculatedTotal.discount,
          total: calculatedTotal.final,
          paymentMethod: '',
          notes: appliedCoupon ? `Cupom aplicado: ${appliedCoupon.code}` : 'Agendado pelo App'
        };

        setAppointments(prev => [...prev, newApt]);
        
        // Atualiza contador do cupom se usado
        if (appliedCoupon) {
          setCoupons(prev => prev.map(c => c.code === appliedCoupon.code ? { ...c, usageCount: c.usageCount + 1 } : c));
        }

        showToast('Agendamento realizado com sucesso!');
        setWizardStep(1);
        setClientStep('home');
      };

      // D. Ações do Barbeiro
      const handleStartAppointment = (id) => {
        setAppointments(prev => prev.map(a => a.id === id ? { ...a, status: 'em_atendimento' } : a));
        showToast('Cliente chamado para a cadeira!');
      };

      const handleFinishAppointment = (id, paymentMethod = 'PIX') => {
        setAppointments(prev => prev.map(a => a.id === id ? { ...a, status: 'concluido', paymentMethod } : a));
        showToast('Atendimento finalizado com sucesso! Comissão registrada.');
      };

      // E. Adicionar Produto à Comanda
      const handleAddProductToAppointment = (appointmentId, product) => {
        setAppointments(prev => prev.map(a => {
          if (a.id === appointmentId) {
            const newTotal = a.total + product.price;
            return {
              ...a,
              total: newTotal,
              notes: a.notes + ` | + ${product.name} (R$ ${product.price})`
            };
          }
          return a;
        }));
        // Reduz estoque
        setProducts(prev => prev.map(p => p.id === product.id ? { ...p, stock: Math.max(0, p.stock - 1) } : p));
        setQuickAddProductModal({ isOpen: false, appointmentId: null });
        showToast(`Adicionado: ${product.name} (R$ ${product.price})`);
      };

      // F. Criar Novo Cupom
      const handleSaveNewCoupon = (e) => {
        e.preventDefault();
        if (!newCouponForm.code.trim()) return;
        const couponObj = {
          code: newCouponForm.code.trim().toUpperCase(),
          type: newCouponForm.type,
          value: Number(newCouponForm.value),
          minDays: Number(newCouponForm.minDays || 0),
          expiresAt: newCouponForm.expiresAt || '2026-12-31',
          active: true,
          usageCount: 0,
          desc: newCouponForm.desc || `Cupom ${newCouponForm.code}`
        };
        setCoupons(prev => [couponObj, ...prev]);
        setNewCouponModal(false);
        setNewCouponForm({ code: '', type: 'percent', value: 15, minDays: 20, expiresAt: '2026-12-31', desc: '' });
        showToast(`Cupom ${couponObj.code} criado com sucesso!`);
      };

      const handleToggleCoupon = (code) => {
        setCoupons(prev => prev.map(c => c.code === code ? { ...c, active: !c.active } : c));
        showToast('Status do cupom atualizado.');
      };

      // G. Disparo de Mensagem de Retenção (E-mail / WhatsApp)
      const handleTriggerMarketing = (client, channel = 'whatsapp') => {
        // Seleciona o melhor cupom com base nos dias sem vir
        let recommendedCoupon = coupons.find(c => c.code === 'BEMVINDO10');
        if (client.daysInactive >= 60) recommendedCoupon = coupons.find(c => c.code === 'RESGATE25') || recommendedCoupon;
        else if (client.daysInactive >= 35) recommendedCoupon = coupons.find(c => c.code === 'SAUDADES20') || recommendedCoupon;
        else if (client.daysInactive >= 20) recommendedCoupon = coupons.find(c => c.code === 'VOLTEI15') || recommendedCoupon;

        setMarketingModal({
          isOpen: true,
          client,
          coupon: recommendedCoupon,
          channel
        });
      };

      const handleConfirmSendMarketing = () => {
        if (!marketingModal.client || !marketingModal.coupon) return;
        const { client, coupon, channel } = marketingModal;
        
        if (channel === 'whatsapp') {
          const text = encodeURIComponent(
            `Olá, ${client.name}! Tudo bem?\n\nAqui é da Valverd's BarberShop 💈.\n\nNotamos que faz ${client.daysInactive} dias desde seu último corte com ${client.favoriteBarber}. Para você voltar e dar aquele alinhamento de respeito no visual, preparamos um benefício exclusivo:\n\n✂️ Use o cupom *${coupon.code}* e ganhe *${coupon.type === 'percent' ? coupon.value + '%' : 'R$ ' + coupon.value} de desconto* no seu agendamento esta semana!\n\nAgende direto pelo nosso app ou responda esta mensagem para reservarmos seu horário. Te aguardamos!`
          );
          window.open(`https://wa.me/55${client.phone.replace(/\D/g, '')}?text=${text}`, '_blank');
          showToast(`Conversa aberta com ${client.name} no WhatsApp!`);
        } else {
          // Simula envio de e-mail
          showToast(`E-mail com cupom ${coupon.code} enviado para ${client.email}!`);
        }

        // Atualiza data do último contato
        setCrmClients(prev => prev.map(c => c.id === client.id ? { ...c, lastContact: new Date().toLocaleDateString('pt-BR') } : c));
        setMarketingModal({ isOpen: false, client: null, coupon: null });
      };

      // =========================================================================
      // DADOS COMPUTADOS (KPIs & Filtros)
      // =========================================================================
      
      // Barbeiro Ativo (se estiver no modo barbeiro)
      const currentBarberAppointments = useMemo(() => {
        return appointments.filter(a => a.barber === currentUser.name || (currentUser.role === 'barbeiro' && a.barber.includes('Yago')));
      }, [appointments, currentUser]);

      const inChairAppointment = useMemo(() => {
        return currentBarberAppointments.find(a => a.status === 'em_atendimento');
      }, [currentBarberAppointments]);

      const nextAppointment = useMemo(() => {
        return currentBarberAppointments.find(a => a.status === 'aguardando');
      }, [currentBarberAppointments]);

      const barberEarningsToday = useMemo(() => {
        const completed = currentBarberAppointments.filter(a => a.status === 'concluido');
        const revenue = completed.reduce((acc, a) => acc + (a.total || a.price), 0);
        return {
          count: completed.length,
          revenue,
          commission: revenue * 0.50
        };
      }, [currentBarberAppointments]);

      // Métricas do Dono
      const ownerMetrics = useMemo(() => {
        const completed = appointments.filter(a => a.status === 'concluido');
        const revenue = completed.reduce((acc, a) => acc + (a.total || a.price), 0);
        const inServiceCount = appointments.filter(a => a.status === 'em_atendimento').length;
        const waitingCount = appointments.filter(a => a.status === 'aguardando').length;
        return {
          totalCompleted: completed.length,
          revenue,
          inServiceCount,
          waitingCount,
          ticketMedio: completed.length ? revenue / completed.length : 0
        };
      }, [appointments]);

      // Filtro CRM de Clientes
      const filteredCrmClients = useMemo(() => {
        if (crmFilter === 'em_dia') return crmClients.filter(c => c.daysInactive <= 20);
        if (crmFilter === 'retorno') return crmClients.filter(c => c.daysInactive > 20 && c.daysInactive <= 35);
        if (crmFilter === 'ausente') return crmClients.filter(c => c.daysInactive > 35 && c.daysInactive <= 60);
        if (crmFilter === 'inativo') return crmClients.filter(c => c.daysInactive > 60);
        return crmClients;
      }, [crmClients, crmFilter]);


      // =========================================================================
      // RENDERIZAÇÃO DA INTERFACE
      // =========================================================================
      return (
        <div className="min-h-screen bg-[#0B0B0B] text-[#E6E4E0] flex flex-col antialiased selection:bg-[#C9A356] selection:text-black">
          
          {/* TOPO EXECUTIVO / TOPBAR */}
          <header className="bg-[#12110E] border-b border-[#242018] px-4 md:px-8 py-3 sticky top-0 z-40 backdrop-blur-lg bg-opacity-95">
            <div className="max-w-7xl mx-auto flex flex-col md:flex-row justify-between items-center gap-3">
              
              {/* Marca & Identidade */}
              <div className="flex items-center gap-3 cursor-pointer" onClick={() => setCurrentView('site')}>
                <OfficialLogo className="w-10 h-10" />
                <div>
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                    <span className="font-serif font-bold text-base tracking-wider text-white">VALVERD'S</span>
                    <span className={`text-[9px] font-serif font-bold px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full uppercase tracking-wider ${
                      currentUser.role === 'dono' ? 'bg-[#C9A356] text-black' :
                      currentUser.role === 'barbeiro' ? 'bg-blue-600 text-white' :
                      currentUser.role === 'dev_marketing' ? 'bg-purple-600 text-white' :
                      'bg-emerald-600 text-white'
                    }`}>
                      {currentUser.role === 'dono' ? 'PROPRIETÁRIO' :
                       currentUser.role === 'barbeiro' ? 'BARBEIRO' :
                       currentUser.role === 'dev_marketing' ? 'DEV / MARKETING' : 'CLIENTE'}
                    </span>
                  </div>
                  <div className="text-[11px] text-gray-400">
                    {currentUser.name} — <span className="text-[#C9A356]">{currentUser.title}</span>
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>

              {/* Seletor Rápido de Perfil (Para Demonstração & Teste) */}
              <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 bg-[#181612] p-1 rounded-full border border-[#2D271F] overflow-x-auto max-w-full">
                <button
                  onClick={() => switchRole('dono')}
                  className={`px-3 py-1 rounded-full text-[11px] font-serif font-bold transition-all flex items-center gap-1.5 ${currentUser.role === 'dono' && currentView === 'painel' ? 'bg-[#C9A356] text-black' : 'text-gray-400 hover:text-white'}`}
                >
                  <Icons.Crown className="w-3 h-3" />
                  <span>Dono</span>
                </button>
                <button
                  onClick={() => switchRole('barbeiro')}
                  className={`px-3 py-1 rounded-full text-[11px] font-serif font-bold transition-all flex items-center gap-1.5 ${currentUser.role === 'barbeiro' && currentView === 'painel' ? 'bg-[#C9A356] text-black' : 'text-gray-400 hover:text-white'}`}
                >
                  <Icons.Scissors className="w-3 h-3" />
                  <span>Barbeiro</span>
                </button>
                <button
                  onClick={() => switchRole('cliente')}
                  className={`px-3 py-1 rounded-full text-[11px] font-serif font-bold transition-all flex items-center gap-1.5 ${currentUser.role === 'cliente' && currentView === 'painel' ? 'bg-[#C9A356] text-black' : 'text-gray-400 hover:text-white'}`}
                >
                  <Icons.User className="w-3 h-3" />
                  <span>Cliente</span>
                </button>
                <button
                  onClick={() => switchRole('dev_marketing')}
                  className={`px-3 py-1 rounded-full text-[11px] font-serif font-bold transition-all flex items-center gap-1.5 ${currentUser.role === 'dev_marketing' && currentView === 'painel' ? 'bg-purple-600 text-white' : 'text-gray-400 hover:text-white'}`}
                >
                  <Icons.Tag className="w-3 h-3" />
                  <span>Marketing & Cupons</span>
                </button>
              </div>

              {/* Ações Rápidas: Alternar Visão & Instalar App */}
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <button
                  onClick={() => setCurrentView(currentView === 'site' ? 'painel' : 'site')}
                  className="px-3.5 py-1.5 rounded-full bg-[#181612] hover:bg-[#25221B] text-gray-300 hover:text-white text-xs font-serif transition-all border border-[#2D271F] flex items-center gap-1.5"
                >
                  <Icons.Home className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                  <span>{currentView === 'site' ? 'Abrir Painel' : 'Ver Site Público'}</span>
                </button>

                <button
                  onClick={handleInstallPwa}
                  className="px-3 py-1.5 rounded-full bg-[#1F1C16] hover:bg-[#C9A356] hover:text-black text-[#C9A356] text-xs font-serif font-bold transition-all border border-[#C9A356]/40 flex items-center gap-1.5"
                  title="Instalar na tela do celular como aplicativo"
                >
                  <Icons.Smartphone className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                  <span className="hidden sm:inline">Instalar App</span>
                </button>
              </div>

            </div>
          </header>

          {/* ========================================================================= */}
          {/* VISÃO 1: SITE PÚBLICO DE PRESTÍGIO                                       */}
          {/* ========================================================================= */}
          {currentView === 'site' && (
            <main className="flex-1">
              
              {/* HERO SECTION */}
              <section className="relative min-h-[70vh] flex items-center justify-center text-center px-4 py-16 bg-gradient-to-b from-[#12110E] to-[#0B0B0B] border-b border-[#1E1B15]">
                <div className="max-w-3xl mx-auto space-y-6">
                  <div className="flex justify-center">
                    <OfficialLogo className="w-28 h-28 md:w-36 md:h-36" />
                  </div>
                  <div className="space-y-2">
                    <span className="text-xs font-serif uppercase tracking-[0.3em] text-[#C9A356] font-semibold">Resende — Rio de Janeiro</span>
                    <h1 className="font-serif text-3xl md:text-5xl font-bold text-white tracking-wide">
                      VALVERD'S BARBERSHOP
                    </h1>
                    <p className="text-xs md:text-sm font-light text-gray-400 tracking-widest uppercase">
                      BEARD, HAIR AND MUSTACHE
                    </p>
                  </div>
                  <p className="text-sm md:text-base text-gray-300 max-w-xl mx-auto font-light leading-relaxed">
                    Cortes clássicos e contemporâneos, toalha quente, lounge climatizado e navalha de precisão. O padrão de excelência que seu visual merece.
                  </p>
                  <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row justify-center items-center gap-3 pt-4">
                    <button
                      onClick={() => { switchRole('cliente'); setClientStep('wizard'); }}
                      className="w-full sm:w-auto px-8 py-3.5 rounded-full bg-[#C9A356] hover:bg-[#B59044] text-black font-serif font-bold text-xs uppercase tracking-widest shadow-gold transition-all flex items-center justify-center gap-2"
                    >
                      <Icons.Calendar className="w-4 h-4" />
                      <span>Agendar Horário Online</span>
                    </button>
                    <a
                      href="https://wa.me/5521970100668"
                      target="_blank"
                      rel="noreferrer"
                      className="w-full sm:w-auto px-8 py-3.5 rounded-full bg-[#181612] hover:bg-[#25221B] text-[#E0DDD5] border border-[#2D271F] font-serif text-xs uppercase tracking-widest transition-all flex items-center justify-center gap-2"
                    >
                      <Icons.MessageSquare className="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-400" />
                      <span>WhatsApp Direto</span>
                    </a>
                  </div>
                </div>
              </section>

              {/* SERVIÇOS & VALORES */}
              <section className="py-16 px-4 md:px-8 max-w-6xl mx-auto space-y-10">
                <div className="text-center space-y-2">
                  <span className="text-[11px] font-serif uppercase tracking-widest text-[#C9A356] font-bold">Menu de Serviços</span>
                  <h2 className="font-serif text-2xl md:text-3xl font-bold text-white">Nossos Cuidados</h2>
                  <div className="w-16 h-0.5 bg-[#C9A356] mx-auto mt-2"></div>
                </div>

                <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-6">
                  {SERVICES_LIST.map(service => (
                    <div key={service.id} className="bg-[#12110E] p-6 rounded-2xl border border-[#242018] hover:border-[#C9A356]/50 transition-all flex flex-col justify-between space-y-4">
                      <div className="space-y-2">
                        <div className="flex justify-between items-start">
                          <span className="text-[10px] uppercase font-serif px-2 py-0.5 rounded bg-[#1C1A14] text-[#C9A356] border border-[#2E281F]">
                            {service.duration} min
                          </span>
                          <span className="font-serif font-bold text-lg text-[#C9A356]">
                            R$ {service.price.toFixed(2).replace('.', ',')}
                          </span>
                        </div>
                        <h3 className="font-serif font-bold text-base text-white">{service.name}</h3>
                        <p className="text-xs text-gray-400 leading-relaxed">{service.desc}</p>
                      </div>
                      <button
                        onClick={() => { setSelectedService(service); switchRole('cliente'); setClientStep('wizard'); setWizardStep(2); }}
                        className="w-full py-2.5 rounded-xl bg-[#181612] hover:bg-[#C9A356] text-gray-300 hover:text-black text-xs font-serif font-bold transition-all border border-[#2D271F] flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5"
                      >
                        <span>Escolher Este Serviço</span>
                        <Icons.ArrowRight className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                      </button>
                    </div>
                  ))}
                </div>
              </section>

              {/* PROFISSIONAIS / EQUIPE */}
              <section className="py-16 px-4 md:px-8 bg-[#100F0D] border-t border-b border-[#1E1B15]">
                <div className="max-w-4xl mx-auto space-y-10">
                  <div className="text-center space-y-2">
                    <span className="text-[11px] font-serif uppercase tracking-widest text-[#C9A356] font-bold">A Bancada</span>
                    <h2 className="font-serif text-2xl md:text-3xl font-bold text-white">Nossos Barbeiros</h2>
                    <div className="w-16 h-0.5 bg-[#C9A356] mx-auto mt-2"></div>
                  </div>

                  <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-8">
                    {BARBERS_DATA.map(barber => (
                      <div key={barber.id} className="bg-[#14120F] p-6 rounded-3xl border border-[#242018] flex items-center gap-5">
                        <img
                          src={barber.avatar}
                          alt={barber.name}
                          className="w-20 h-20 rounded-full object-cover border-2 border-[#C9A356] shadow"
                          onError={(e) => { e.target.onerror = null; e.target.src = 'assets/barbeiro_valverds.jpg'; }}
                        />
                        <div className="space-y-1.5">
                          <span className="text-[10px] font-serif uppercase text-[#C9A356] font-semibold">{barber.chair}</span>
                          <h3 className="font-serif font-bold text-lg text-white">{barber.name}</h3>
                          <p className="text-xs text-gray-400">{barber.handle}</p>
                          <button
                            onClick={() => { setSelectedBarber(barber); switchRole('cliente'); setClientStep('wizard'); setWizardStep(3); }}
                            className="mt-2 text-xs font-serif text-[#C9A356] hover:underline flex items-center gap-1"
                          >
                            <span>Agendar com {barber.name.split(' ')[0]}</span>
                            <Icons.ArrowRight className="w-3 h-3" />
                          </button>
                        </div>
                      </div>
                    ))}
                  </div>
                </div>
              </section>

              {/* LOCALIZAÇÃO & CONTATO */}
              <section className="py-16 px-4 md:px-8 max-w-5xl mx-auto space-y-8 text-center">
                <div className="space-y-2">
                  <span className="text-[11px] font-serif uppercase tracking-widest text-[#C9A356] font-bold">Visite Nosso Espaço</span>
                  <h2 className="font-serif text-2xl md:text-3xl font-bold text-white">Localização & Contato</h2>
                  <div className="w-16 h-0.5 bg-[#C9A356] mx-auto mt-2"></div>
                </div>

                <div className="bg-[#14120F] p-8 rounded-3xl border border-[#242018] space-y-4 max-w-xl mx-auto">
                  <div className="flex items-center justify-center gap-2 text-[#C9A356]">
                    <Icons.MapPin className="w-5 h-5" />
                    <span className="font-serif font-bold text-sm">Resende — Rio de Janeiro</span>
                  </div>
                  <p className="text-sm text-gray-300">
                    R. Antônio Veloso Júnior, 77 — Campos Elíseos, Resende - RJ, 27542-120
                  </p>
                  <p className="text-xs text-gray-400">
                    WhatsApp: (21) 97010-0668 | Horário: Terça a Sábado das 09:00 às 19:30
                  </p>
                  <div className="pt-2">
                    <a
                      href="https://maps.google.com/?q=Valverd's+BarberShop+Resende"
                      target="_blank"
                      rel="noreferrer"
                      className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 px-5 py-2.5 rounded-full bg-[#1D1A14] hover:bg-[#29241C] text-[#C9A356] text-xs font-serif font-semibold border border-[#332C20] transition-all"
                    >
                      <Icons.MapPin className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                      <span>Abrir no Google Maps</span>
                    </a>
                  </div>
                </div>
              </section>

            </main>
          )}

          {/* ========================================================================= */}
          {/* VISÃO 2: PAINEL PROGRESSIVO (BARBEIRO, CLIENTE, DONO, DEV/MARKETING)      */}
          {/* ========================================================================= */}
          {currentView === 'painel' && (
            <main className="flex-1 max-w-7xl w-full mx-auto p-4 md:p-8 space-y-8">

              {/* ===================================================================== */}
              {/* CASO A: ÁREA DO BARBEIRO (LINHA DE COMEÇO, MEIO E FIM)                */}
              {/* ===================================================================== */}
              {currentUser.role === 'barbeiro' && (
                <div className="space-y-8">
                  
                  {/* Cabeçalho da Bancada & Sub-abas Focadas */}
                  <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row justify-between items-start sm:items-center gap-4 pb-4 border-b border-[#211E18]">
                    <div>
                      <span className="text-[10px] font-serif uppercase tracking-widest text-[#C9A356] font-bold">Bancada do Profissional</span>

                    </div>

                    {/* Alternador de Modo: Hoje (Padrão e Limpo) vs Escala */}
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-2 bg-[#161410] p-1 rounded-full border border-[#262118]">
                      <button
                        onClick={() => setBarberSubView('hoje')}
                        className={`px-4 py-1.5 rounded-full text-xs font-serif font-bold transition-all ${barberSubView === 'hoje' ? 'bg-[#C9A356] text-black shadow' : 'text-gray-400 hover:text-white'}`}
                      >
                        Hoje (Foco no Corte)
                      </button>
                      <button
                        onClick={() => setBarberSubView('escala')}
                        className={`px-4 py-1.5 rounded-full text-xs font-serif font-bold transition-all ${barberSubView === 'escala' ? 'bg-[#C9A356] text-black shadow' : 'text-gray-400 hover:text-white'}`}
                      >
                        Minha Escala & Horários
                      </button>
                    </div>
                  </div>

                  {barberSubView === 'hoje' && (
                    <div className="space-y-8">

                      {/* ============================================================= */}
                      {/* ATO 1: COMEÇO (SPOTLIGHT - QUEM ESTÁ NA CADEIRA AGORA)        */}
                      {/* ============================================================= */}
                      <div className="space-y-3">
                        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                          <div className="w-2.5 h-2.5 rounded-full bg-emerald-500 animate-pulse"></div>
                          <span className="text-xs font-serif uppercase tracking-wider text-emerald-400 font-bold">
                            {inChairAppointment ? 'Em Atendimento Agora' : 'Próximo Cliente da Fila'}
                          </span>
                        </div>

                        {inChairAppointment ? (
                          <div className="bg-gradient-to-r from-[#181611] to-[#12110E] p-6 md:p-8 rounded-3xl border-2 border-[#C9A356]/60 shadow-gold space-y-6">
                            <div className="flex flex-col md:flex-row justify-between items-start md:items-center gap-4">
                              <div className="space-y-1">
                                <span className="text-[11px] font-serif uppercase px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded bg-[#C9A356]/20 text-[#C9A356] font-bold border border-[#C9A356]/30">
                                  Iniciado às {inChairAppointment.time}
                                </span>
                                <h3 className="font-serif text-2xl md:text-3xl font-bold text-white pt-1">
                                  {inChairAppointment.client}
                                </h3>
                                <p className="text-sm text-gray-300 font-medium">{inChairAppointment.service}</p>
                                {inChairAppointment.notes && (
                                  <p className="text-xs text-gray-400 italic">"{inChairAppointment.notes}"</p>
                                )}
                              </div>

                              <div className="text-right">
                                <span className="text-[10px] text-gray-400 uppercase font-serif">Valor do Serviço:</span>
                                <div className="font-serif font-bold text-2xl text-[#C9A356]">
                                  R$ {inChairAppointment.total.toFixed(2).replace('.', ',')}
                                </div>
                                <span className="text-[11px] text-green-400 font-serif">
                                  Sua Comissão: R$ {(inChairAppointment.total * 0.5).toFixed(2).replace('.', ',')}
                                </span>
                              </div>
                            </div>

                            {/* Ações Diretas: Apenas o Essencial */}
                            <div className="pt-4 border-t border-[#29241C] flex flex-wrap items-center gap-3">
                              <button
                                onClick={() => handleFinishAppointment(inChairAppointment.id, 'PIX')}
                                className="px-6 py-3 rounded-full bg-[#C9A356] hover:bg-[#B59044] text-black font-serif font-bold text-xs uppercase tracking-wider transition-all shadow flex items-center gap-2"
                              >
                                <Icons.CheckCircle className="w-4 h-4" />
                                <span>Concluir Corte & Registrar Pagamento</span>
                              </button>

                              <button
                                onClick={() => setQuickAddProductModal({ isOpen: true, appointmentId: inChairAppointment.id })}
                                className="px-5 py-3 rounded-full bg-[#1E1B15] hover:bg-[#28231B] text-gray-200 text-xs font-serif font-semibold border border-[#30291F] transition-all flex items-center gap-2"
                              >
                                <Icons.Package className="w-4 h-4 text-[#C9A356]" />
                                <span>+ Bebida / Pomada na Comanda</span>
                              </button>

                              <a
                                href={`https://wa.me/55${inChairAppointment.phone.replace(/\D/g, '')}`}
                                target="_blank"
                                rel="noreferrer"
                                className="px-5 py-3 rounded-full bg-[#1E1B15] hover:bg-[#28231B] text-emerald-400 text-xs font-serif font-semibold border border-[#30291F] transition-all flex items-center gap-2"
                              >
                                <Icons.MessageSquare className="w-4 h-4" />
                                <span>Chamar no WhatsApp</span>
                              </a>
                            </div>
                          </div>
                        ) : nextAppointment ? (
                          <div className="bg-[#14120E] p-6 rounded-3xl border border-[#242018] flex flex-col sm:flex-row justify-between items-start sm:items-center gap-4">
                            <div className="space-y-1">
                              <span className="text-[10px] font-serif uppercase px-2 py-0.5 rounded bg-[#1D1B15] text-amber-400 font-bold border border-[#2E271D]">
